item.title: Kara Braxton: Former Phoenix Mercury player dies at 43
item.description: Kara Braxton, a former player for the Phoenix Mercury, died at the age of 43, the WNBA announced on Feb. 23."It is with profound sadness that we mourn the passing of 2x WNBA Champion Kara Braxton," the league wrote on X. "A 10-season veteran, Kara played with the Detroit Shock, Tulsa Shock, Phoenix Mercury, and New York Liberty. item.title: Alleged racial taunts, spitting at Arizona high school basketball game prompts investigations
item.description: A state representative is calling for an investigation into alleged racial taunts being used during a basketball game between two Arizona high schools on Friday night.The incident occurred during a 3A boys basketball quarterfinal game at Coolidge High School, against Chinle High, on Feb. 20. item.description: The Department of Homeland Security on Monday revealed its plans for a $70M building it bought in Surprise, saying it'll serve as a short-term processing center for up to 1,500 illegal immigrants.Federal officials confirmed the facility, at Sweetwater Avenue and Dysart Road, will serve as an intake and transfer site for people placed into removal proceedings.
